column1: public,get_universal_metrics_v2,"p_organization_id uuid, p_period text, p_from date, p_to date",jsonb,"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_universal_metrics_v2(p_organization_id uuid, p_period text DEFAULT 'current_fy'::text, p_from date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_to date DEFAULT NULL::date)
IF p_from IS NOT NULL AND p_to IS NOT NULL THEN
WHEN 'last_month'   THEN v_from := (DATE_TRUNC('month', v_today) - INTERVAL '1 month')::date
WHEN 'all_time'     THEN v_from := COALESCE((SELECT MIN(entry_date) FROM journal_entries WHERE organization_id = p_organization_id), v_today - INTERVAL '5 years')
INTO v_revenue, v_expenses, v_owner_rent, v_maintenance, v_housekeeping,
FROM journal_lines jl JOIN journal_entries je ON je.id = jl.journal_entry_id
JOIN coa_accounts ca ON ca.id = jl.account_id
AND ca.code IN ('1110', '1120') AND je.entry_date BETWEEN v_from AND v_to
AND jl.debit > 0 AND je.is_reversal_of IS NULL
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM journal_entries r WHERE r.is_reversal_of = je.id)
FROM journal_lines jl JOIN journal_entries je ON je.id = jl.journal_entry_id
JOIN coa_accounts ca ON ca.id = jl.account_id
AND ca.code = '2100' AND je.entry_date BETWEEN v_from AND v_to
AND jl.credit > 0 AND je.is_reversal_of IS NULL
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM journal_entries r WHERE r.is_reversal_of = je.id)
FROM journal_lines jl JOIN journal_entries je ON je.id = jl.journal_entry_id
JOIN coa_accounts ca ON ca.id = jl.account_id
AND ca.code IN ('1110', '1120') AND je.entry_date BETWEEN v_from AND v_to

JOIN apartments a ON a.id = b.apartment_id
